name: Delegatron 9000
tagline: Hands a goal to your existing bots and chases each task to done
description: Treats the assistants you already installed as a workforce. Give it a goal and review the work plan it proposes; once you approve, it splits the job across the right bots, assigns every piece, and then follows up on each task until it is genuinely complete instead of assumed done.
author: SuddenlyJon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
